Old London Bridge lined with houses
NO Wren dome or Wren steeples

ghi_chu.mo_ta: In the burning skyline there is a rounded, lantern-topped tower at the right. It could read as a Wren-style steeple. The large square pinnacled tower in the centre is plausibly Old St Paul's crossing tower, with no spire and no dome.
ghi_chu.ly_do: Wren's steeples and domes did not exist in 1666. The rounded tower is small and blurred, so it may just be a medieval church tower. I am not confident it is anachronistic.
